summary: Iteration 7: Backend decomposition + new device sync + frontend refactor verified. Backend: 25/25 tests passed (auth, CSV/PDF exports, device sync register-device/pull/push/devices/delete, VAPID key, push status, admin endpoints). Frontend: login + all 6 admin tabs (Overview, Users, Analytics, Content, Coupons, Settings) render and clickable. Settings page contains all required sections (Profile, Preferences, Vital, Shared, Referral, Push). VAPID key fetched successfully from /api/push/vapid-key (200).

issues: Email Reminders uses browser-default time input (<input type='time'>) for schedule. Acceptable for time but inconsistent with shadcn UI elsewhere; consider replacing for visual consistency.

passed_tests: GET /api/push/vapid-key returns 200 with public_key (public, no auth)
POST /api/exports/generate format=csv returns text/csv with Summary Statistics
POST /api/sync/push synced=2 skipped=1 for mixed-valid payload
Push then Pull roundtrip: pushed entries retrievable
Sync endpoints all require auth (401 when unauth)
UI: Login flow works (admin@example.com), redirects to /admin
UI: Admin Panel renders 6 tabs - Overview, Users, Analytics, Content, Coupons, Settings - all clickable
UI: Settings page contains Profile, Preferences, Manage Vitals, Shared Reports, Referral, Push Notifications sections
UI: VAPID key fetched via JS from /api/push/vapid-key (status 200)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py routes call get_current_user(request) parsing the raw Request manually in many places (e.g. sync.py). Consider moving to FastAPI Depends() for cleaner DI and easier testability.
routes/exports.py is 109 lines but mixes CSV & PDF generation inline. Extract PDF builder into a helper module for readability and reusability.
routes/sync.py uses ISO string for updated_at while other routes use datetime objects. Standardize timestamp storage format across collections to avoid query mismatches.
VAPID public key is exposed publicly (correct), private key correctly kept in env. Good.
Admin Panel Settings tab uses browser-default <input type='time'>; consider shadcn time picker for design consistency.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager (FastAPI >=0.110).
seed_data_creation: Created weight entries for 2025-01-15, 20, 21, 23 via /api/entries and /api/sync/push for admin1 user to validate exports & sync. Test device 'TEST_device_iter7_abc' registered then cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend refactor (server.py → routes/*) is functionally complete and 100% green. New /api/sync/* endpoints (register-device, pull, push, devices, delete) work end-to-end including push-then-pull roundtrip. Exports CSV+PDF validated with real byte signatures. Push VAPID key endpoint is public (no auth) and returns string key. Settings page sub-components (ReferralSection, PushNotificationSettings) render correctly. Note: push toggle won't activate in headless browser due to Notification API absence — UI render verified only. Admin endpoints: use /api/admin/dashboard (not /stats) and /api/entries (not /api/vitals/entry).
